description: The file defines an API router for handling message-related operations in a FastAPI application, specifically POST requests to send messages within a session. It includes functions for creating a supabase client, validating inputs, checking session ownership, ensuring file uploads for the session, persisting user messages, and returning stub responses.

classes.name: MessageStubResponse
classes.description: A response model representing a stub message from the assistant, including id, role, content, and timestamp.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables for URL and key.

methods.name: create_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a user message in a session, validates input, checks session ownership and uploaded files, persists the message, and returns a stub response.
